### Hardened by Sin’s Deceit
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-february-3-2023.html
Passage: Luke 23:8-9
Points:
- Herod was eager to see Jesus purely out of curiosity, hoping to witness a miraculous display.
- Jesus met Herod with complete silence because He knew the king’s unrepentant, superficial motives.
- Herod had previously enjoyed listening to John the Baptist until John confronted his personal sin.
- Persistently excusing and harboring sin gradually numbs the conscience and hardens the heart.
- Believers must quickly repent of known sin rather than face the solemn silence of Christ.
